identity_collision_and_parent_reset.identity_rule: Enrollment and Parent activation reject an email already owned by an account user whose role is not parent. The shared account-user upsert no longer overwrites role and returns the existing durable user key only for a compatible Parent identity.
identity_collision_and_parent_reset.parent_reset_rule: Reset is bound to exactly one active non-support guardian relationship whose guardian_user_ref resolves to one active role=parent user in the same account/product and household, with a normalized email exactly matching the adult link and contact.
identity_collision_and_parent_reset.replay_and_assurance: Recovery issuance is advisory-lock/idempotency protected; replay returns the same safe outcome. Mutating operator endpoints require CSRF plus recent assurance.
identity_collision_and_parent_reset.proof: Focused domain and web suites cover collisions, role preservation, unconsumed activation tokens, guardian mismatch/missing/unactivated/ambiguous cases, cross-scope denial, replay, CSRF, and recent-assurance denial.

verified_behavior: Paid, complimentary, and administrative-suspension source states are independent; suspension denies, otherwise paid or complimentary grants, otherwise the household is paused.
Complimentary revocation leaves paid truth intact, and suspension/release never mutates billing.
A paused Parent can authenticate only to identity, protected recovery, and Support; Student authentication, sessions, and learning fail closed when effective access disappears.

Atomic idempotent enrollment creates or links one adult and household, prepares pending Parent activation, creates any positive number of local-only Students, optionally grants complimentary access, and queues exactly one adult-only GHL projection.
The canonical Contacts UI supports the complete Owner/Admin one-button flow and a human-readable existing-Parent management path on desktop and 390px Chromium.
Durable adult links expose authorized GHL state/deep-link and one coalesced reconcile action without payment data or child payloads.
Parent recovery remains link-only and generic; Student recovery is adult-authorized, audited, one-time, session-revoking, and never returns a stored plaintext credential.
Identity collisions and guardian-link mismatches fail closed without role mutation, token consumption, or send.
Existing fictional preview behavior remains isolated with exactly three active fictional Students while normal households permit additional Students.
